FileQuest - Swimlane Diagram
01 Connect a Vault

Choose an ordinary directory.
New files enter Lost & Found
until spatially placed.
02 Place a File

Place or reposition a virtual
object. The real file is not
moved by spatial placement.
03 Search & Teleport

Search indexed metadata,
highlight matching objects,
then optionally teleport.
04 Reconcile Changes

Watcher events are hints.
Verify changes before updating
identities or creating ghosts.
05 Open a File

Resolve and verify the current
path, then delegate opening
to the operating system.
launch result
06 Move / Copy / Delete

These operations affect real
files. Confirm destructive bulk
actions; prefer OS trash.
07 Import Environment

Import a user-supplied model.
Model validation precedes
registration and loading.

LEGEND — ONE COMBINED UML ACTIVITY DIAGRAM

Vertical partition Responsible actor / subsystem   ·   Rounded rectangle Action   ·   Arrow Control flow   ·   [condition] Branch guard
Diamond Decision or merge of alternative paths   ·   Filled circle Initial node   ·   Bull’s-eye Activity final
Section headings organise the overview; each selected branch returns to the common continuation point. No fork or simultaneous execution is implied.
Local-first: user files remain ordinary OS files; SQLite stores spatial / presentation metadata. Native-launch acceptance does not prove the document has finished loading.
